America is celebrating 250 years of freedom.  Let's not forget those still paying the price for defending it. K2 veterans have spent 25 years fighting for recognition, care, and accountability.  Stronghold Freedom Foundation is a 100% volunteer organization working everyday to ensure these veterans are never forgotten. You don't celebrate 250 years of freedom by ignoring 25 years of sacrifice. If you can, please help us keep fighting for these veterans  Donate. Share. Advocate.
